title: Pig holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloonGrad' cx='35%' cy='30%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9ec4'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ff4f8b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c4185a'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M50 44 C 47 52 54 54 50 58 C 46 60 52 62 50 66' fill='none' stroke='#7fe3ff' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='26' rx='13' ry='16' fill='url(#balloonGrad)'/>
  <path d='M50 41 L46 45 L54 45 Z' fill='#c4185a'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='19' rx='3.2' ry='4.6' fill='#ffd9e6' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='19' ry='16' fill='#ff9fbe'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='73' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#ffb8d0'/>

  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='38' y='82' width='7' height='11' rx='3' fill='#f2789f'/>
  <rect x='55' y='82' width='7' height='11' rx='3' fill='#f2789f'/>
  <ellipse cx='41.5' cy='93' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#e05a88'/>
  <ellipse cx='58.5' cy='93' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#e05a88'/>

  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='66' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ff9fbe' transform='rotate(-20 31 66)'/>
  <ellipse cx='69' cy='66' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ff9fbe' transform='rotate(20 69 66)'/>
  <!-- raised hand holding string -->
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='60' rx='5.5' ry='4.5' fill='#ffc0d8' transform='rotate(35 57 60)'/>

  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M36 55 Q32 44 40 47 Z' fill='#ff85a8'/>
  <path d='M64 55 Q68 44 60 47 Z' fill='#ff85a8'/>
  <path d='M38 53 Q35 47 39 48 Z' fill='#ffd0e0'/>
  <path d='M62 53 Q65 47 61 48 Z' fill='#ffd0e0'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='17' ry='15' fill='#ffa8c4'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='63' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#ffc8dc'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='56' r='3.2' fill='#5a1030'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='56' r='3.2' fill='#5a1030'/>
  <circle cx='44.2' cy='54.8' r='1.2' fill='#fff0f6'/>
  <circle cx='58.2' cy='54.8' r='1.2' fill='#fff0f6'/>

  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#ff7ea6'/>
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='64' rx='1.7' ry='2.4' fill='#b3244f'/>
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='64' rx='1.7' ry='2.4' fill='#b3244f'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 68.5 Q50 72 55 68.5' fill='none' stroke='#b3244f' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='64' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff5f92' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='64' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff5f92' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
